questions.question: Which of the "3 R's" is considered the most effective way to manage resources and why?

options.A: Recycle, because it turns old materials into new ones.
options.B: Reuse, because it gives products a second life.
options.C: Reduce, because it stops waste from being created in the first place.
options.D: Recycle, because it saves space in landfills.

questions.explanation: Reducing is the most effective because it prevents waste from ever being generated, which is better than having to deal with it later.

questions.question: How do the "3 R's" directly connect to the biblical mandate for Creationeers™?

options.A: They help us earn more money to donate to the church.
options.B: They show our obedience to human laws about waste disposal.
options.C: They are practical ways to live out our call to be good stewards of God's creation.
options.D: They prove that humans are superior to all other creatures.

questions.explanation: The lesson states that the 3 R's are practical ways to live out God's call for us to be good stewards of His creation, managing resources wisely.

questions.question: In the OCV method applied to reducing food waste in a school cafeteria, which of the following would be considered a "Variable"?

options.A: The school must provide nutritious meals.
options.B: Minimizing the amount of food waste generated.
options.C: The budget for food procurement cannot increase significantly.
options.D: The portion sizes offered to students.

questions.explanation: Variables are elements that can be changed or adjusted to help achieve the objective, such as portion sizes, types of food, or availability of compost bins.

questions.question: When the lesson connects overflowing landfills (macro-level) to reducing plastic use (atomic-level), what is the atomic-level cause being addressed by reducing plastic?

options.A: Fewer large pieces of trash ending up in the ocean.
options.B: Less need to synthesize long-chain polymer molecules from petroleum.
options.C: The breakdown of plastic into smaller microplastic particles.
options.D: Fewer trucks transporting waste to disposal sites.

questions.explanation: At the atomic level, reducing plastic means fewer long-chain polymer molecules need to be synthesized from raw petroleum, directly impacting resource extraction.

questions.question: Within the Creationeering™ framework, the "3 R's" (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle) are primarily tools used in which phase?
questions.explanation: The lesson states that the 3 R's are powerful principles within the Creationeering™ framework, specifically in the Sustainability phase.
